supersedes.reason: PR #192 used a redundant selector branch and the generic candidate pipeline. No result from that run is eligible for threshold selection.

source_evidence.interpretation: Operation-narrow has materially more ranking headroom than the generic gate path, but BGE score thresholds do not provide a safe open-set boundary.

hypothesis: Replacing the operation-narrow BGE relevance boundary with a multilingual entailment-oriented score can improve the distinction between semantically related requests and actually supported registered operations while preserving schema-bounded authority.

model.hypothesis_template: The user is requesting exactly this operation: {operation_text}

architecture: Use the existing graph-first v4 candidate surface and operation_fit_mode=narrow.
Preserve semantic candidate recall, graph semantic seed, ranked-only propagation, corroboration, and static option caching exactly as in the existing operation-narrow experiment.
Disable generic capability-fit exactly as in PR #191 so the experiment isolates the operation boundary.
Replace only the bounded operation-fit pairwise scorer from BGE relevance to multilingual NLI entailment.
An accepted NLI result may narrow only the already-authorized leading-tool sibling set; no route, tool, field, argument, or authority is synthesized.

selection_rule.dataset: same fresh v4 1800-case tuning-eligible development corpus
selection_rule.primary: Among candidates passing every standing development gate, choose the highest supported exact-route accuracy; tie-break by lower canonical false-route rate, then lower p95 latency.
selection_rule.no_passing_candidate: Reject NLI-as-single-boundary for promotion and proceed to independently typed multi-signal evidence; do not invent intermediate thresholds after seeing results.

research_hygiene: Do not inspect or use the superseded PR #192 NLI outputs for threshold selection.
Do not alter the frozen threshold grid after inspecting this run.
Do not use calibration or blind corpora for development selection.
Do not add corpus-derived negative phrases or unsupported-family labels to the NLI input.
If a candidate passes all development gates, freeze its complete configuration before any confirmation corpus is evaluated.
